parse_prompt_attention: parse a prompt string with attention tokens and return weighted text pairs
get_weighted_text_embeddings: generate weighted text embeddings from prompts with bracket-based attention weighting
run_pipeline_text2img: run text-to-image generation using OnnxStableDiffusionLongPromptWeightingPipeline with long prompt support
run_pipeline_inpaint: run image inpainting with OnnxStableDiffusionLongPromptWeightingPipeline using a mask to repaint regions
run_pipeline_img2img: run image-to-image generation using OnnxStableDiffusionLongPromptWeightingPipeline with strength control
